page_title: RSO 2-0 CAD | Real Sociedad v Cadiz CF 15/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Cadiz CF are ruled offside.
90+2' Jon Magunazelaia Argoitia (Real Sociedad) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
90+2' Real Sociedad work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+2' A sweet pass finds Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top right corner. Conan Ledesma is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
90+1' 5:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The game is interrupted. Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
86' The substitution has been made. Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) has replaced Juanmi.
86' We are about to witness a substitution. Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) is replacing Ruben Sobrino.
84' Substitution. Sheraldo Becker makes his way off the pitch and Jon Magunazelaia Argoitia (Real Sociedad) comes on as his replacement.
82' Here is a change. Robert Navarro is going off and Mauricio Pellegrino gives the last tactical orders to Darwin Machis (Cadiz).
82' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lucas Pires (Cadiz) for Javi Hernandez.
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
80' Dangerous play by Javi Hernandez (Cadiz). Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Real Sociedad.
79' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
76' Cesar Soto Grado blows the whistle, Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is penalised for a foul. Free kick. Cadiz CF will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
75' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
75' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Martin Zubimendi and he is replaced by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Oyarzabal trots off the pitch and is replaced by Andre Silva (Real Sociedad).
74' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Cadiz CF was in an offside position.
73' The attendance is 31000.
70' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
70' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
70' The ball goes out for a corner. Cadiz CF can continue in their attacking effort.
70' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF have been awarded a corner kick.
68' 2 - 0 Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) latches on to a pass and finds himself in a great position inside the box before unleashing a stunning effort into the top of the net.
66' It will be a substitution. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is ready to enter the pitch as Takefusa Kubo walks off.
60' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Alex Remiro.
59' A player from Cadiz CF takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
58' The referee awards a corner and Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) goes over to take it.
58' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) will take a corner kick.
58' Conan Ledesma makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) after a cross from the side.
57' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for an infringement.
52' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad).
51' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) commits a rough foul. Cesar Soto Grado stops the game and makes a call.
47' Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
46' The referee signals a substitution. Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Javi Galan.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Juanmi (Cadiz) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45+3' The resulting free kick from Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
45+2' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
45+1' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cadiz CF.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.

45' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Alex Remiro leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball is out of play and Cadiz CF manage to earn a corner.
44' Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle and signals a foul after Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) brought his opponent down.
43' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
42' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
42' Real Sociedad quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

41' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) gets inside the box and tries to beat Conan Ledesma with a measured shot into the left side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The referee signals a corner kick to Real Sociedad.

40' Chance! Iza Carcelen sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Chris Ramos (Cadiz), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
39' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) sees his long-range effort blocked.
34' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Chris Ramos replaces him.
33' The game is interrupted now, Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
28' 1 - 0 Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a great through ball and coolly strikes the ball into the top right corner!
28' The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

28' The ball is crossed into the box and Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the top right corner, but Conan Ledesma gets a glove on it to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Sociedad.
27' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Robert Navarro (Cadiz), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
26' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
24' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
19' Real Sociedad are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
16' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
13' A snap shot by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Conan Ledesma produces a good save to thwart him.
11' Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Cesar Soto Grado signals.
8' An attempted cross from Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) is cleared.
7' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
6' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Cesar Soto Grado.
